home.heading: Things I'm making
home.subheading: My experiment with getting the idea down early.
home.intro: An idea becomes a Project when I post it on here. Nothing becomes Art until it's been made. I know the world doesn't need another art blog – this one is designed to motivate me to finish these projects and actually create something. I hope you find it interesting.

updates.heading: Project updates
updates.intro: Short updates as things move: a decision, a test, a photo from the bench.

handsOn.heading: Try them here
handsOn.intro: A digital piece you can only experience on this site, and 3D models of the physical work to turn, take apart and look inside.

notArt.heading: The other things I'm building
notArt.intro: Not everything I make hangs on a wall. These are the organisations I've started, both about helping people plan for what comes later in life.

contact.heading: Get in touch
contact.intro: Questions about a piece, commissions, or just to say hello. I read every message.
